children: SEVIORA AND FIRST ABU DHABI BANK ANNOUNCE STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP TO UNLOCK NEW INVESTMENT AND MARKET OPPORTUNITIES
MOU WILL PROVIDE A STRONG FOUNDATION FOR CLOSER COLLABORATION BETWEEN THE TWO FIRMS
FIRMS WILL LEVERAGE THEIR EXPANDED NETWORKS AND COMPLEMENTARY EXPERTISE TO DRIVE GROWTH AND BROADEN MARKET REACH
COLLABORATION WILL ALSO SUPPORT GREATER KNOWLEDGE SHARING AND THE EXCHANGE OF BEST PRACTICES
FAB WILL EXPLORE OPPORTUNITIES TO DISTRIBUTE INVESTMENT STRATEGIES MANAGED BY SEVIORA AND ITS AFFILIATES
